about_p1: Richard F. handled my AAA tow from Pawtucket to North Attleboro and was kind enough to let me ride along so I could pick up another car from the shop. He has towed my other vehicle for me in the past. Very efficient and professional. It's always a pleasure dealing with him. I highly recommend Richard F.
about_p2: King Towing is the BEST! They were extremely fast and affordable! Cody the driver showed up in 15 mins and very friendly. Hopefully we don't break down again, but if we do I'm call them! Go to tow company! been trapped at the house for 2 weeks and finally low on supplies, unfortunately slid and was unable to get out of my driveway, King Towing came out with their incredible reversing skills and winched me out.
